title: Aeronautics x Protomanly
description: Bridge between aeronautics and protomanly weather
body: Adds **compatibility between the Create Aeronautics mod and Protomanly Weather**. A sail system has been implemented (the wind takes into account not only the block's weight but also its cross-sectional area); in the future, a tornado destruction system, player interaction with the wind while building, and the ability for lightning to strike structures will be implemented!
